breaks.quote: If the answer is no, prune. Pick something that still matters to you and prune it.
breaks.why: The ask to end things that still matter rests on one personal story and a short reader list, so a doubtful reader can shrug and keep everything.

breaks.quote: Pruning hurts, and it will hurt you too.
breaks.why: The cost is only stated, and the reader's strongest doubt (why end something valuable) is never answered with a reason before the ask.

breaks.quote: But what you truly need, you can go back to with a clear mind and restart from a fresh seed
breaks.why: The benefit comes in one sentence after the ask, so the case for pruning is named, not built.
